_note: Pattern rules for the Beema compliance gate. level BLOCK = cannot ship; REVIEW = needs a human decision. The gate NEVER marks anything 'approved'. Patterns are regex, case-insensitive. Derived from docs/marketing/SEO-AEO-GEO-PLAN.md F1.1/F1.2, FDA statements (Feb 6 2026), legitscript/meta/google compliance skills.

global_block.msg: Em dash is banned in all Beema copy.
Brand or non-offered drug name. Beema creative never names brands.
Guarantee language. Only 'never guaranteed' is allowed.

global_block.re: \b(instant(ly)?|immediate(ly)?|within minutes|works fast|fast[- ]acting|works quickly|quick results|miracle|cures?d?|clinically proven|doctor[- ]approved|100 ?%|no side effects|risk[- ]free|completely safe|totally safe|proven to|works for everyone)\b

global_block.msg: Weight-loss outcome claim or before/after framing.
Testimonial or invented patient experience. Not allowed without signed releases and legal review.

global_block.re: \b(act now|hurry|limited time|today only|last chance|don't wait|before it's too late)\b

global_block.msg: FDA approval attributed to Beema or its service.
Do not call facilities FDA-approved. Use 'FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility' only where verified.

compounded_block.re: \b(same as|same active|same ingredient|identical|equivalent|interchangeable|generic version|alternative to|copy of|drop-in|just like)\b
compounded_block.msg: Equivalence claim for a compounded product (FDA Feb 6 2026).
Percent/efficacy statistic near a compounded GLP-1 (trial data must be walled off).

peptide_block.msg: Healing, repair, recovery, treatment or relief claim. BPC-157 has no established human benefit and no FDA-approved use.
Safety, efficacy or evidence claim about a peptide with limited human data. Say what is unknown instead.
Dosing, protocol or stacking language. Not allowed without clinical review.
Names a body part, condition or use case. That implies a benefit; keep the video to what it is and what is unknown.

review.msg: Onset/timing statement. Verify against pharmacy/label documentation; never transfer tablet timing to Mints.
Duration statement. Confirm wording and that 4-hour priapism warning is not confused.
LegitScript named. Seal/certification language must follow certification-language-usage rules; never in ad creative.
Unquantified prevalence statement. Needs a cited source or rewording.
History/study reference. Needs a cited source.

review.re: \b(a few|just a few|couple of|two|three|five|ten|\d+) (minutes|seconds)\b|takes (just )?(minutes|seconds)|\bin (minutes|seconds)\b|under a minute
review.msg: Process or video duration claim. Needs substantiation.

ad_block.msg: Ad copy asserting or implying a personal health condition.
